description: Agent Nonprofit Records: submit restricted-gift records with the spending records they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each restricted gift with its id, reference, donor, amount, currency, the moment received, the restricted purpose the gift record states, the restriction as the ledger records it, the moment the restriction term ends in the gift record and in the ledger, any change of purpose the records assert and the donor consent record it cites; each spending record with its id, the gift it is charged to, the moment, the amount and the purpose it names; each release with its id, the gift, the moment, the amount and a note; each donor consent record with its id, reference, the gift, the moment given and the purpose consented to. The signed report gives the gifts and the spending, each spending record against the purpose the restriction covers or a changed purpose the donor’s recorded consent covers, each restriction as the gift record and the ledger record it, each balance left past the restriction term against a release, and each change of purpose against a donor consent record, and counts them, and names divergent restricted-gift records: a restricted gift spent outside its stated purpose, restriction terms recorded differently in the gift record and the ledger, a restricted balance carried past its term with no spending or release recorded, and a change of purpose asserted with no record of donor consent; then spending and releases above the gift and a spending or release record naming a gift the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No gifts, no spending records, a gift with no stated purpose, or no reading moment beside a term leaves those points unverified. Gifts and records match by letters and digits, a stated purpose covers a spending purpose when every word of it appears there with plurals folded, amounts compare to the cent and terms by the day. This reads whether each restriction a donor placed on a gift holds in the spending. Verdict nonprofit_restriction_divergent, nonprofit_restriction_partial, nonprofit_restriction_unverified or nonprofit_restriction_consistent. POST /api/nonprofit-restriction-check. Reads the nonprofit records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it solicits no donation, contacts no donor, files no form and gives no tax or legal advice, which stay with the organization and its advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Nonprofit Records reads a nonprofit’s own records: donation records, pledge records, restricted-gift records, fundraising campaign records, board and governance records, volunteer records, program spending records and the annual report written for donors and the public, each against the acknowledgment and ledger records, the collections, the spending records, the gift records and costs, the bylaws, votes and budgets, the shift records and policy, the mission and grant-purpose records or the records underneath it. The family’s ground is the nonprofit’s own house: money given, promises made by donors, restrictions placed on gifts, and what the board and the annual report say about all of it; the Agent Grants family reads the grant side, applications out and awards in, and the Agent Tax Records family reads filings made to the government, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-nonprofit-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-nonprofit-records/.
